title: Utility Transfer Failure Rate
dataSources: Move checklists (`move:checklist`), USPS change-of-address (`usps:change`), mover quotes (`mover:quote`), utility transfers (`utility:transfer`), and box inventories (`box:inventory`).
app: Move checklist task exports, USPS change-of-address confirmations, mover quote comparisons, utility transfer logs, and box inventory scans forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=utility:transfer
| eval status_value=lower(coalesce(transfer_status,"unknown"))
| eval failed=if(match(status_value,"error|fail|alert|overdue|late|stale|breach"),1,0)
| stats count as events, sum(failed) as failed_events by utility_type
| eval failure_pct=round(100*failed_events/events,1)
| sort - failure_pct - failed_events
description: Measures how often utility transfer records land in an unhealthy or exception state for each utility type.
value: A plain failure-rate view highlights noisy devices, flaky automations, and habits that repeatedly slip.
implementation: Normalize transfer_status values into good or bad states and review the failure percentage per utility type.
visualization: Bar chart of failure percentage by entity.
grandmaExplanation: It turns which parts of your utility transfer data keep ending up in a bad state instead of working cleanly.
